# Status Change View Template

Use this template for stakeholder-facing status updates. The focus is movement and its implications, not a static snapshot. Mark change as up, down, or unchanged.

Decision: <the named decision this update informs>
Confidence legend: red is Low, amber is Medium, green is High.

| Dimension               | Confidence           | Change since last      | Why changed                | What this enables                  |
|-------------------------|----------------------|------------------------|----------------------------|------------------------------------|
| Problem Confidence      | Low / Medium / High  | up / down / unchanged  | Specific evidence or event | Decision enabled or blocked        |
| Data Confidence         | Low / Medium / High  | up / down / unchanged  |                            |                                    |
| Feasibility Confidence  | Low / Medium / High  | up / down / unchanged  |                            |                                    |
| Signal Confidence       | Low / Medium / High  | up / down / unchanged  |                            |                                    |
| Applicability Confidence | Low / Medium / High  | up / down / unchanged  |                            |                                    |
| Operational Confidence  | Low / Medium / High  | up / down / unchanged  |                            |                                    |

Lead the update with what moved, in which direction, and why. Confidence can move down as well as up; a new decision or dependency can re-open a dimension that was previously strong.
